concerns.text: T003 (Configure linting) and T008a (Create .env template) are marked as incomplete/missing in the task list, yet T008b (Implement .env loading) and T039 (Run ruff/black) depend on them. The spec requires a functional environment (FR-001, FR-008) and the plan assumes these tools are available. Missing tasks for these prerequisites prevent the implementation of dependent user stories.

T008a is listed as a task but marked with [ ] (incomplete) in the list, while T008b depends on it. The plan explicitly requires 'Strategy B (Raw FASTQ)' which needs QIIME2/DADA2. There is no task to install or configure these tools (e.g., via Conda/Docker) in Phase 2 or Phase 3, creating a gap for FR-001 (Data Ingestion) if Strategy A fails.

T052, T053, and T054 are listed in Phase 7 (Revision & Gap Resolution) but are not tagged to any User Story or FR/SC. While they address gaps, they are not linked to the specific requirements they fix (e.g., T054 addresses memory constraints for FR-002/US-2). Without tags, it is unclear if these tasks fully cover the scope of the original requirements or if they are ad-hoc fixes.

T019 appears twice: once as 'Implement zero-variance taxa exclusion' (correct) and again as 'Unit test for CLR transformation logic' (incorrect ID/description mismatch). The second T019 should be a distinct ID (e.g., T019b or T040d) to avoid confusion and ensure the test task is properly tracked against US-2.

T034a-Null and T034a-Model use non-standard IDs with suffixes. While descriptive, they break the sequential numbering pattern (T034, T035) and make it harder to trace against the plan's T034-A/B/C. Ensure these are clearly mapped to the plan's T034-B and T034-A respectively to maintain traceability.
